title: Mnesis Skeleton Layout Registry
description: Schema for skeleton layout entries: one JSON file per keypoint topology. Authority: SPEC.md §Hand keypoints / C11 (Parthenon#47). A layout declares how many joints a keypoint vector carries and what each index means, so a canonical frame can carry a VARIABLE-length keypoint vector plus a layout id instead of hard-coding one vendor's joint count. Same mechanism as the embodiment registry's joint_names for observation.state.

id.description: Layout identifier, used as filename stem and as the value of observation.hand.layout (e.g. 'mediapipe_hand_21').

kind.description: What the layout describes. 'hand' layouts are referenced by observation.hand.layout; 'body' is reserved for the body-pose half of C11.

status.description: Field-level status (see SPEC §Versioning). 'experimental' layouts MAY be renamed or reshaped before they go stable; 'stable' layouts are frozen.

joint_count.description: Number of joints K. A position vector for this layout has exactly 3*K numbers; an orientation vector has exactly 4*K.

joint_names.description: Joint names in wire order — index i of this array names elements [3i, 3i+1, 3i+2] of the position vector. Length MUST equal joint_count.

parents.description: Parent index per joint (-1 = root). Length MUST equal joint_count. This is the skeleton tree used for retargeting and visualisation; it is derived from the source spec's connection list.

has_orientation.description: Whether the upstream source natively provides per-joint orientation. Informational: producers that have it fill observation.hand.<side>.rot, which is optional regardless.

length_unit.description: Length unit of the position vector. SI metres — canonical does not accept other units.

source_spec.description: URL of the upstream specification this layout mirrors.

notes.description: Free-form caveats (e.g. what a down-projection from another layout loses).
